5098.theorem: fixed-chamber active-chart hypergraph equals C2 positive-root coset hypergraph
5098.strengthening: the isomorphism matches the chart/root-coset hyperedges, not only the point graphs

5100.statement: For N positive roots, |U|=q^N and each positive-root subgroup has q elements, hence the total root-direction coset count is N q^(N-1), the formal derivative of q^N.
5100.boundary: general root-coset count; apartment-code active-chart identification is separately certified in rank two
